title: juniperus sabina subsp. arenaria
intro: Juniperus sabina subsp. arenaria, commonly known as Savin juniper or Rocky Mountain juniper, is a subspecies of evergreen shrub or small tree that belongs to the cypress family (Cupressaceae). This plant is valued for its traditional medicinal uses, where it has been used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Juniperus sabina subsp. arenaria are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and diuretic properties, as well as its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
